name: Speak with Deino
summary: "Speak with Deino" is a summons directing promising Horde mages to seek out a skilled practitioner in Orgrimmar. Deino, a troll mage operating out of the Valley of Spirits, requires an adept to undertake critical work on behalf of their craft. Answering her call opens the path to deeper magical study and vital tasks across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Summons to Orgrimmar
sections.body: As practitioners of the arcane hone their abilities within the Horde, instructors in Undercity and Kalimdor recognize when a student is prepared for more demanding ventures. Mentors like Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity or Quithas in Durotar point developing mages toward Orgrimmar. There, tucked away in the troll-dominated quarter, more specialized knowledge and perilous errands await.

sections.title: The Valley of Spirits and Darkbriar Lodge
sections.body: Deino makes her home within the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Among the Darkspear, dedicated practitioners of the arcane are relatively rare compared to witch doctors and priests, making Deino a notable authority in the capital. She works not just for local concerns, but for the broader interests of the Horde's arcane practitioners, seeking ambitious mages willing to brave distant perils.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Deino?
aliases: where do i get speak with deino
faq.answer: Mage trainers such as Anastasia Hartwell in the Magic Quarter of Undercity and Quithas in Durotar send aspiring mages to Orgrimmar once they reach sufficient skill.
Deino is located inside the Darkbriar Lodge, nestled in the Valley of Spirits on the western side of Orgrimmar.
Deino oversees important research and tasks deemed vital to the society of Horde mages. She enlists capable spellcasters to venture into dangerous lands to secure rare magical resources.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Deino?
faq.answer: Once you report to Deino, she briefs you on her mission and sends you on your next assignment, beginning with gathering the Waters of Xavian.

faq.q: Is this quest available to all classes?
faq.answer: No. This quest is exclusively offered to mages of the Horde as part of their dedicated class progression and training.

faq.q: Are troll mages common in the Horde?
faq.answer: Arcane magic is less common among the Darkspear trolls than spiritual shamanism, voodoo, or loa priesthood. However, figures like Deino show that some trolls have thoroughly mastered the formal study of arcane forces.

angles.text: This quest is a pivotal step in your formal arcane training, connecting you to senior spellcasters in Orgrimmar.
Deino represents the focused arcane discipline practiced by a select few among the Darkspear tribe.
The summons bridges regional trainers from Lordaeron and Durotar into the centralized arcane leadership gathering in Orgrimmar.
